mapper.sql: select bm_storage_material_batch.id, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.code as material_code, bm_material.merge_code as merge_code, bm_material.specification as material_specification, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.original_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.unit_id, bm_storage_material_batch.unit_extend_id, bm_storage_material_batch.expired_date, bm_material_category.category_type, bm_material.expand_info as expand_info_json from bm_storage_material_batch left join bm_material on bm_storage_material_batch.material_id = bm_material.id left join bm_material_category on bm_material_category.id = bm_material.material_category_id
mapper.update: update bm_storage_material_batch set expire_warning_flag = 0 where material_id = #{materialId} and is_deleted = 0

select.where:
bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bm_material.is_deleted = 0
and bm_material.name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.materialName}, '%')
and bm_material.merge_code like concat('%', #{pageQuery.mergeCode}, '%')
and bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no like concat('%', #{pageQuery.materialBatchNo}, '%')
and bm_storage_material_batch.id in
#{item}
and 1 = -1
order by bm_storage_material_batch.create_time desc

mapper.select: select batch.id as materialBatchId, batch.material_id, batch.material_batch_no, batch.original_batch_no as originalCode, batch.expired_date, batch.factory_batch_no as originalBatchNo, batch.hydration, batch.no_hydration_content, batch.supplier, batch.producer, batch.produce_date, batch.report_no, batch.licence_no, material.unit_id, sum(material.reserve_quantity + material.available_quantity) as materialQuantity from bm_storage_material_batch batch join bm_storage_material material on material.storage_material_batch_id = batch.id join bm_storage_material_reserve reserve on reserve.storage_material_id = material.id where material.is_deleted = 0 and reserve.is_deleted = 0 and reserve.batch_id = #{batchId} and material.material_id = #{materialId} group by batch.id order by batch.material_batch_no
mapper.sql: select bm_storage_material_batch.id as storage_material_batch_id, bm_material_category.category_type, bm_material.id as material_id, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.merge_code, bm_material.code as material_code, bm_material.specification as material_specification, bm_material.dying_period as dying_period, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.factory_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.expired_date, bm_storage_material_batch.produce_date, bm_storage_material_batch.hydration, bm_storage_material_batch.no_hydration_content, bm_storage_material_batch.report_no, bm_storage_material_batch.licence_no, bm_storage_material_batch.original_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.supplier, bm_storage_material_batch.producer, bm_storage_material_batch.quality_status, if(bm_storage_material_batch.unit_extend_id is null, bm_storage_material_batch.unit_id, bm_storage_material_batch.unit_extend_id) as unit_id, (select ifnull(sum(init_quantity), 0) from bm_storage_material where bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id and bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 and (bm_storage_material.sign_status is null or bm_storage_material.sign_status = 1)) as init_quantity, (select ifnull(sum(available_quantity), 0) from bm_storage_material where bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id and bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 and (bm_storage_material.sign_status is null or bm_storage_material.sign_status = 1)) as available_quantity, (select ifnull(sum(reserve_quantity), 0) from bm_storage_material where bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id and bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 and (bm_storage_material.sign_status is null or bm_storage_material.sign_status = 1)) as reserve_quantity, (select ifnull(sum(consume_quantity), 0) from bm_storage_material where bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id and bm_storage_material.is_deleted = 0 and (bm_storage_material.sign_status is null or bm_storage_material.sign_status = 1)) as consume_quantity from bm_storage_material_batch left join bm_material on bm_storage_material_batch.material_id = bm_material.id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 left join bm_material_category on bm_material_category.id = bm_material.material_category_id and bm_material_category.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 and bm_material_category.is_deleted = 0 and bm_storage_material_batch.id = #{id}
order by bm_material.merge_code asc, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no

select bm_storage_material_batch.id, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.code as material_code, bm_material.merge_code as merge_code, bm_material.specification as material_specification, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.original_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.unit_id, bm_storage_material_batch.unit_extend_id, bm_storage_material_batch.expired_date, bm_material.expand_info as expand_info_json, bm_material.material_category_id, SUM(bm_storage_material.available_quantity) as available, SUM(bm_storage_material.reserve_quantity) as reserve, SUM( CASE WHEN bm_storage_material.available_quantity > 0 OR bm_storage_material.reserve_quantity > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS `size` from bm_storage_material_batch left join bm_material on bm_storage_material_batch.material_id = bm_material.id left join bm_storage_material on bm_storage_material.storage_material_batch_id = bm_storage_material_batch.id
bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bm_material.is_deleted = 0
and bm_material.name like concat('%', #{pageQuery.materialName}, '%')
and bm_material.merge_code like concat('%', #{pageQuery.mergeCode}, '%')
and bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no like concat('%', #{pageQuery.materialBatchNo}, '%')
and bm_storage_material.material_position_id in
#{item}
and 1 = -1
group by bm_storage_material_batch.id order by bm_storage_material_batch.create_time desc

select bm_storage_material_batch.id as storage_material_batch_id, bm_material.id as material_id, bm_material.name as material_name, bm_material.merge_code, bm_material.code as material_code, bm_material.specification as material_specification, bm_material.dying_period as dying_period, bm_storage_material_batch.material_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.factory_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.expired_date, bm_storage_material_batch.produce_date, bm_storage_material_batch.hydration, bm_storage_material_batch.no_hydration_content, bm_storage_material_batch.report_no, bm_storage_material_batch.licence_no, bm_storage_material_batch.original_batch_no, bm_storage_material_batch.supplier, bm_storage_material_batch.producer, bm_storage_material_batch.quality_status from bm_storage_material_batch left join bm_material on bm_storage_material_batch.material_id = bm_material.id and bm_material.is_deleted = 0 where bm_storage_material_batch.is_deleted = 0 and bm_storage_material_batch.expire_warning_flag = 0 and bm_storage_material_batch.expired_date is not null and date_sub(bm_storage_material_batch.expired_date,interval if(bm_material.dying_period is null,0,bm_material.dying_period) day ) <= now()
